verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a 'Data Storage Location (US or EU)' option, which is a direct region choice, though the item is only a heading attached to an unrelated Slack docs URL. Sentry also ships a self-hosted edition that runs entirely on your own server, which a long-term user confirms works reliably, giving full control over where data lives. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on selecting a region (how and when to choose, which data is covered, whether migration is possible), any residency options beyond US/EU, and independent corroboration of the SaaS region feature.
